Institute for Sustainable Process Technology (ISPT) (2018). Deep Eutectic Solvents in the paper industry: Towards 40% energy savings and 80% CO2 emission reductions. PROVIDES project results booklet (document DES-20-01), ISPT, Amersfoort, October 2018. www.providespaper.eu. No DOI.

Year is 2018 (foreword dated October 2018; PDF created 2018-10-08); to-get.csv lists it as "ISPT 2020" - the "20" in the file name DES-20-01 is a document number, not the year. Issuer is ISPT for the PROVIDES consortium. The booklet is a 20-page project brochure with no absolute energy, cost or emissions numbers for DES pulping: loaded only description, state of development, target year (2030) and planned mill size (50,000 t). The relative targets (>=40% energy, -50% investment), lab achievements and sector-wide estimates are in _other-values. Page numbers are printed page numbers, which equal PDF pages (pp.2-3 unnumbered; PDF page used). The 80% CO2 in the title is the CEPI 2050 roadmap/cluster objective, not a DES result (p.19 estimates about 10% sector CO2 saving).
